name: Plate Reverse Curl
research: One weight plate (r 0.225) held by the top of its rim in both fists, palms down (axis [-1,0,0]; library step 1), hands ~0.27 m apart (about 10:30 and 1:30 on the rim, plate face forward). START: arms down, elbows soft (elev 12.5 / plane 140.0 / elbow 20.0), fists ~9 cm in front of the hips so the hanging plate clears the thighs. END: elbows at the sides, curled until the forearms point up (elev 15.0 / plane 120.0 / elbow 130.0; library step 2): the plate turns with the wrists and stands above the fists in front of the face (offline ~7 cm clear). Plate placed by place_fixtures rim mode (fists on a ring 1.2 cm inside the outer edge). Facts: research/plate_reverse_curl.json.
